Karaoke Voice Reducer

Reduce centered vocals for karaoke practice using the classic L−R center-channel technique. Honest about its limits.

Needs a real stereo file — mono files can't be processed.

Honest limits: L−R cancels everything panned center — lead vocals, but also kick, bass and snare. Stereo/off-center vocals and effects survive. Results vary per track.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose a stereo audio file.
  2. Click "Reduce vocals" — the center channel is cancelled with the L−R technique.
  3. Preview the result.
  4. Download the karaoke-style WAV.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does vocal reduction work?

Subtracting right from left cancels anything panned center — usually the lead vocal, but also kick, bass and snare. Stereo effects and off-center backing vocals survive.

When does it fail?

It only works on true stereo tracks with centered vocals. Mono files, and songs with stereo or off-center vocals, won't reduce properly.

Is my audio uploaded?

Yes — processing happens in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
